title: Sharp regularity for degenerate fully nonlinear equations with oblique boundary conditions and Hamiltonian terms
summary: We prove optimal boundary $C^{1,α}$ regularity for viscosity solutions of degenerate fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations with oblique boundary conditions and Hamiltonian terms of the form \[ \begin{cases} |Du|^γF(D^2 u) + \varrho(x)|Du|^σ = f(x) & \text{in } Ω,\\ β(x)\cdot Du+ζ(x)u = g(x) & \text{on } \partial Ω, \end{cases} \] where $γ>0$ and $0<σ\le 1+γ$. We develop a compactness framework for affine translations, linking the size of the translation to the Hamiltonian structure. This is combined with a boundary improvement-of-flatness argument adapted to oblique boundary data,…
